These pledges could be in the form of a precious object, like a ring or a piece of land. The name Gibb honored those who upheld their promises and showcased the importance of loyalty and commitment in the society.

It symbolizes the covenant between God and his people, represented in the Old Testament through the sacrifices and the promises God made to his people. Just as the name Gibb signified a pledge and a commitment in the early medieval society, it also represents the commitment and unwavering love God has for his people. The name Gibb is a reminder of the faithfulness and the covenant promises that God has made to us.
